hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: A severe institutional crisis has erupted in Poland as President Karol Nawrocki directly confronts Prime Minister Donald Tusk over the takeover of the Constitutional Tribunal. Jarosław Kaczyński and PiS leaders have escalated rhetoric by accusing the government of lawlessness, chaos, and orchestrating a "criminal group" style takeover.
hotspots.affect: High-octane institutional warfare framing paints the government's moves as an existential threat to the rule of law and a literal coup.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Bolsonarismo remains in a state of intense upheaval following Flávio Bolsonaro's flight to Florida amid Supreme Court money laundering investigations and passport seizures. Allies and family members are rallying around him, framing the judiciary's actions under Alexandre de Moraes as political persecution and lawfare.
hotspots.affect: Furious defense of a belezzuered political figure combines with grievance-laden narratives of judicial overreach and persecution.

hotspots.title: Urda Train Disaster & Spanish Right Poll Surge
hotspots.blurb: The political fallout from the Urda train disaster continues to dominate Spanish coverage, with PP and Vox capitalizing heavily on the tragedy to excoriate Pedro Sánchez's government. Opinion polls show the conservative and far-right bloc surging toward a historic absolute majority amid fierce public recriminations.
hotspots.affect: Exploitation of a national tragedy for maximum political leverage, combining intense moral outrage with triumphant electoral projections.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: The Rassemblement National continues to command heavy media focus as Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella dominate French political discourse ahead of 2027. Coverage highlights aggressive opposition attacks, debate over economic proposals like salary hikes over the SMIC, and controversies surrounding vandalism of party offices.
hotspots.affect: Combines a sense of unstoppable momentum and governing ambition with defensive outrage over media hostility and local clashes.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage MP Altercation Row & Reform Campaign
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK and Nigel Farage are facing intense scrutiny and internal turbulence following severe criminal charges brought against high-profile local figures alongside ongoing campaign controversies. Farage has aggressively defended the party's hardline anti-migration platform while pushing back against regulatory pressure.
hotspots.affect: High-stress defensive crisis framing mixed with defiant populist posturing and fierce attacks on mainstream political opponents.
